{{Top|leg}}
'''Helk''' was an individual who was not convinced that [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]] was acting on the best behalf of primitive [[Planet/Legends|planets]], to which it provided trade concessions for the purchase of [[I-C2 Civil-Industrial Droid/Legends|I-C2 construction droids]]. Helk learned that VLS provided the construction droids in return for the right to build new [[Factory/Legends|factories]] in the reconstructed [[City/Legends|cities]].
